parisDecoOff2027.title: CJM Group at Paris Déco Off 2027
parisDecoOff2027.excerpt: See you in Paris. From 13 to 16 January, CJM Group will take part in Paris Déco Off 2027 to present the new BASSARI collections.
parisDecoOff2027.visitNote: Our showroom: 19 Rue de Seine, 75006, Paris.

sections.title: A meeting with design in Paris
paragraphs: From 13 to 16 January 2027, Paris Déco Off will bring international design houses and decorating professionals together in Paris. An opportunity to discover ideas, exchange perspectives and explore the world of fabrics and interior design.

sections.title: Discover the new BASSARI collections
paragraphs: CJM Group will attend this new edition with the latest BASSARI collections. Discover them up close and discuss fresh ideas for your interior projects with our team.
We want this meeting to be a space for conversation and inspiration: a chance to explore the collections together and consider their possibilities in every interior.

sections.title: Plan your visit
paragraphs: Save the dates: 13 to 16 January 2027. Visit the official Paris Déco Off website for event information and updates.
Visit our showroom at 19 Rue de Seine, 75006, Paris. Contact us if you would like to arrange a meeting with our team.
